entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Producer prices today either confirm the October CPI impulse or they do not. The swing is the subsequent pull of the March forward, not a one-print scalp.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: March 2027 implied SOFR reprices higher from 4.615 if the path off 3.89 cash catches up with a repeated inflation impulse and Brent near 96.

entry_rationale: Pay March 2027 SOFR. Notional is set so a 100 basis point shock stays inside the 100 million risk-capital limit and near the 60 million adverse path the book can live with.
entry_thesis: October CPI at 0.4 percent and Brent at 95.82 leave cash SOFR at 3.89 low versus a path that is only 4.615 by March 2027. The two-year at 4.86 and the ten-year at 5.1 show the impulse is already in the cash curve, which is a reason to size the pay so a squeeze does not threaten the book, not a reason to receive in front of oil and the CPI print. Canada and Australia are different paths. Dollar-yen at 159.70 is the wrong dollar expression. The concentrated book is one outright March SOFR pay, plus a flat hold so the book is not only that new risk.

events.rationale: Pay March 2027 SOFR. Notional is set so a 100 basis point shock stays inside the 100 million risk-capital limit and near the 60 million adverse path the book can live with.

invalidation: Close the pay if March 2027 SOFR trades at or below 4.40, which would unwind the inflation impulse. Do not add a euro short or a yen short to soften it.
